metadata.name: Undergate Transit
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: The transit hub of an underground research facility: a vast rock cavern ringed by a monorail beam 8 m up, where two hover cars lap all match and run down anyone on the track. Fight across the two-level Central Station, the glass-fronted security checkpoint and the maintenance tunnel behind it, the control tower (its console seals the blast doors of the hazard vault in the loading docks, where the rockets and armour are), the toxic waste pools and the old rail yard. Jump pads and elevator shafts put you up on the beam.

do.text: Undergate Transit. Keep clear of the monorail beam: cars do not stop.
Containment breach: hazard vault blast doors sealed for 20 seconds.
